# SlideEdit

**Class:** `UltraCanvasSlideEdit` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasSlideEdit.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasSlideEdit.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasSlideEdit.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

**Edit** a presentation: the slide strip, shapes to select, move, resize, turn and order with snapping, new slides from layouts, text and tables in place, undo (the show is `UltraCanvasSlideShowPlayer`; the model is `PptxPresentation`, the core `UCSlideDeckEditor`)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSlideEdit> CreateSlideEdit(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasSlideEdit(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onChange` | `std::function<void()> onChange` | the deck changed (and undo / redo) |
| `onSelectionChange` | `std::function<void()> onSelectionChange` | the slide or the selection changed |
| `onEditText` | `std::function<void(int shape)> onEditText` | A shape's text is to be edited (double-click, Enter, F2). |
| `onEditTableCell` | `std::function<void(int shape, int row, int col)> onEditTableCell` | A table's cell is to be edited (double-click on a table). |
| `onEditChart` | `std::function<void(int shape)> onEditChart` | A chart's data is to be edited (double-click on a chart). |
| `onModeChange` | `std::function<void()> onModeChange` | The view or crop mode changed (SetView, a double-click in the sorter, the end of cropping). |
| `onContextMenu` | `std::function<void(bool inStrip, int slide, int shape, int windowX, int windowY)> onContextMenu` | Right-click: `slide` the slide under it in the strip (or the slide shown), `shape` the shape under it on the slide (-1: none, or in the strip); `windowX`, `windowY` where, for a menu. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
